runtime.rationale: Learner-facing presentation changed: motion tokens + reduced-motion signal, ambient budget (≤ 4 loops), 13 embroidered ornament SVGs on milestone surfaces, press/transition/feedback motion, delta-only counters and progress, one-shot Victory burst, QA panel. No curriculum source changed, so the canonical fingerprint stays 29bb02ec0336 (generator truth). Runtime moved again to 2618683e: the ambient scheduler always arms a timer backup next to the frame, so a suspended or throttled frame can never hold the budget stale (WebKit CI).
